name: Zhejiang Sanfer Electric Co., Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Sanfer Electric Co., Ltd. is an enterprise dedicated to the entire process of kitchen appliance operations, encompassing everything from initial research and design to manufacturing and direct sales. Their extensive product line features essential cooking solutions such as stoves, ovens, and integrated cooking units. Additionally, they provide a diverse selection of washing center items, which include integrated sink dishwashers, built-in dishwashers, standalone integrated sinks, and gas water heaters. The company also supplies a variety of kitchen cabinets. Furthermore, Sanfer Electric extends its offerings to include personalized, end-to-end kitchen customization solutions. These products reach customers through various avenues, including dedicated retail outlets, online sales platforms, and other distribution channels. Established in 1998, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Shaoxing, China.
